### Favorite Books

The books I love often center on people searching for where they belong and navigating the forces that shape who they become. Many explore identity, cultural expectations, family histories, and the experiences of those caught between different worlds. I’m especially drawn to stories that connect personal struggles with larger questions of history, society, and what it means to understand one another.
